name: Necklace of Fireballs

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

last.text: falls apart, its last bead thrown

powers.name: Throw beads
powers.text: Magic action: throw one or more beads up to 60 ft: a level 3 Fireball (save DC 15), one level higher per extra bead.

summary: 1d6 + 3 beads: throw one as a Fireball (save DC 15), or several at once for a bigger one.
text: 1d6 + 3 beads dangle from this necklace. With a Magic action, pull one off and hurl it as far as 60 feet; where it lands, it bursts into a Fireball cast at level 3 (save DC 15). A single Magic action can also fling several beads at once, or the entire necklace, and the Fireball's level goes up by 1 for every bead past the first.
